_comment: L-Nutra VoC sidecar connector settings (SPEC section 9). Copy to server/config.json and edit.
This file never holds a password. The mailbox secret comes from the VOC_MAIL_SECRET environment
variable or the macOS Keychain item with service 'voc-mail' (security add-generic-password -s voc-mail -a <username> -w).
Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the server. Any key containing password/secret/token is rejected.
provider_preset: gmail | google_workspace | yahoo | icloud | generic_imap | microsoft365 (roadmap; basic IMAP auth is disabled there).
host/port: IMAP over TLS. Gmail imap.gmail.com:993, Yahoo imap.mail.yahoo.com:993, iCloud imap.mail.me.com:993.
username: the full mailbox address, e.g. support@l-nutra.com.
auth: 'password' (app password). 'xoauth2' is documented in README.md but not implemented.
folder: mailbox to poll for inbound mail. Gmail labels appear as folders, e.g. 'VoC' or 'Support/Reviews'.

sent_folder: optional; polled with direction 'outbound' so the site can compute first-response times. Gmail '[Gmail]/Sent Mail', Yahoo 'Sent', iCloud 'Sent Messages', Outlook 'Sent Items'. Empty string disables it.
agent_addresses: addresses of your support agents; mail from them is marked outbound even when it sits in the inbox.
poll_interval_s: 60-900 seconds between polls. Errors back off exponentially up to 30 minutes.
since: YYYY-MM-DD for the first scan (IMAP SINCE uses the server's local date). Empty means the whole folder, limited by max_per_poll per pass.
max_per_poll: messages fetched per folder per poll, lowest UID first; a backlog drains across polls.
sender_allow / sender_deny: full addresses or domains ('example.com' or '@example.com'). Allow applies to inbound only; deny always wins.
subject_include / subject_exclude: case-insensitive regular expressions; empty disables the filter.
skip_autoreplies: drop auto-replies, bounces and newsletters detected from headers (Auto-Submitted, Precedence, List-Id, multipart/report, mailer-daemon, subject).
order_prefix: prefix your order numbers use in mail (Shopify '#'); passed through to the browser classifier.

restricted_recipients / restricted_domains: mail to or from these is PHI-adjacent (L-Nutra Health, Med.Ed). It is flagged restricted and, when redact_restricted_on_server is true, stored with body and subject replaced, the sender pseudonymized, other to/cc addresses replaced by <hash>@redacted.invalid, message ids hashed and attachment names blanked before it ever reaches the browser. Hashes are keyed by the per-install salt file in data_dir.

live_data_plaintext: false (default) writes js/live-data.js as an empty set; the served page pulls records through /api/records with the token and no mail lands in the project folder (often iCloud Drive). true writes every stored record into js/live-data.js so the site works from file:// (and for --once cron runs). The sidecar serves that file only to the page itself or to requests carrying the API token.
Every string field must be free of control characters (CR, LF, NUL, ...): a folder name containing CR/LF would be spliced into the IMAP command stream.

data_dir: where records.json, state.json, salt and reports/ live. Keep it outside iCloud Drive (the default is ~/Library/Application Support/voc). The --data-dir flag overrides it; a change here applies at the next server start.
